about: Behaviour checks for delegation (assistant/delegate.go, prompts/agents/delegate.md): an agent's question the assistant answers for the user, or leaves to the user. Synthetic cases only. want: what the hub may end with (answer or ask; any one passes). answers: by question, the option labels that pass when it answers (every question is listed when answer is wanted). refused: by question, an option the hub leaves to the user even when the model picks it (its red-line words). known: why the hub gets the case wrong today; the live check reports it and does not fail on it.
